statement: A torus-stable 337-dimensional slice has ten tangent parameters of weights (-1,2,-3,-2,-1,0,1,1,2,3); exact positive, negative, and fixed-weight obstruction certificates plus a torus-nullcone lemma show that its reduced completed local ring is C. Thus G is reduced-affinely rigid in K_{3,7}, though the local ring is a nonreduced Artin thickening.
